description.value: Beach Ave Bar & Grill is a full-service bar and restaurant situated on Beach Avenue in Vancouver, steps from the English Bay waterfront and the popular Seawall cycling corridor. The restaurant offers both indoor and outdoor seating, making it a natural rest stop for cyclists riding the waterfront route. The menu spans food and drinks with a dedicated weekend brunch program.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (7 spaces) at 84m. Total: 7 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content successfully loaded and confirms the business name, address (1-1012 Beach Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6E 1T7), and phone ((604) 676-2337), all consistent with OSM tags. The site shows an active restaurant with food, drinks, and weekend brunch offerings, and OSM confirms indoor_seating=yes and outdoor_seating=yes. Neither the website nor OSM tags mention bike parking, washrooms, takeout, or any cyclist-specific amenities explicitly, so those are left null per the absence-of-evidence rule.
concerns: Website content appears sparse, likely due to a JavaScript-heavy build; menu details were not captured. Core contact and address data was confirmed but amenity evidence is limited.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active restaurant on the Vancouver waterfront with a live website, confirmed contact details, and no indicators of closure — a natural stop for cyclists on the Seawall route.

wow_evidence: steps from the English Bay waterfront and the popular Seawall cycling corridor
